pretreatments.description: Thermal pretreatment performed in a 10 L agitated autoclave (Autoclave, class IV) at temperatures of 110 °C, 165 °C, and 220 °C using both electric and steam modes. The process lasted for 30 minutes once the target temperature was reached. Electric mode is generally used at laboratory scale, while steam mode is used in industrial plants. Solubilisation of COD and VS were evaluated to determine the degree of disintegration of pretreated sludge.
